name: wifi-card
description: 📶 Print a QR code for connecting to your WiFi (wificard.io)
readme_summary: This JavaScript project, wificard.io, allows users to easily generate and print a physical card containing their WiFi network's login details. It's designed for convenient sharing of WiFi access with guests or household members by presenting the information in a scannable QR code format.
key_features: Generate QR code for WiFi login details
Prettier for code formatting and pre-commit hooks
primary_use_case: To create a physical, shareable card with WiFi credentials via a QR code for easy guest access.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized robot hand is holding a small, elegant card. On the card, a glowing QR code is prominently displayed, with subtle lines of data flowing from the robot's fingertip into the QR code, symbolizing the generation process. Around the card, a faint, ethereal WiFi signal emanates. In the background, a cozy living room setting is visible, with the card placed near a router or on a refrigerator. The overall mood is helpful and convenient. The art style should be a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with soft lighting and a pastel color palette, emphasizing simplicity and ease of use. The repository name 'WiFi Card' is subtly integrated into the design of the card itself.

name: Unity-MCP
description: AI Skills, MCP Tools, and CLI for Unity Engine. Full AI develop and test loop. Use cli for quick setup. Efficient token usage, advanced tools. Any C# method may be turned into a tool by a single line. Works with Claude Code, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor and any other absolutely for free.
readme_summary: Unity-MCP is a C# toolkit for Unity Engine that integrates AI capabilities, enabling developers to create and test AI-driven features within games. It supports a full AI development loop and offers efficient token usage, advanced tools, and seamless integration with various AI models and IDEs.
key_features: AI Skills and MCP Tools for Unity Engine
Full AI development and testing loop
Single-line C# method to tool conversion
Works with Claude Code, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor, and others
primary_use_case: Integrating and developing AI-powered features within the Unity game engine, streamlining the AI development lifecycle for game developers.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan in a bustling Unity game development studio, using a magical chisel to sculpt intricate game assets directly from glowing streams of AI code. The streams originate from various AI icons (like Claude, Gemini, Copilot) and flow into a central Unity editor interface. The artisan's chisel sparks with digital energy, transforming the raw code into polished 3D models and game mechanics. Subtle UI elements showing code snippets and AI prompts are visible on nearby screens. The scene is rendered in a vibrant, 3D isometric illustration style, emphasizing creativity and seamless AI integration in game development.

name: whosthere
description: Local Area Network discovery tool with an interactive Terminal User Interface (TUI) written in Go.  Discover, explore, and understand your LAN in an intuitive way. Knock Knock.. who's there? 🚪
readme_summary: Whosthere is a Go-based Local Area Network discovery tool that provides an interactive Terminal User Interface (TUI) for exploring network devices. It uses multiple unprivileged scanning techniques like mDNS, SSDP, and ARP cache analysis to identify devices and enriches this information with OUI lookups for manufacturer details.
primary_use_case: Discovering and understanding devices on a local area network through an intuitive TUI.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, curious robot with a magnifying glass is peering into a stylized, glowing network cloud. The robot is pointing its magnifying glass at various icons representing devices (laptops, phones, smart speakers) that are emerging from the cloud, each with a small manufacturer logo subtly displayed. Digital particles representing network data flow around the scene. The repository name 'Whosthere' is subtly integrated into a small UI element on the robot's chest. The overall mood is one of discovery and clarity, with a clean, modern aesthetic. Rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a vibrant, approachable color palette.

name: intercept
description: iNTERCEPT, a free and open-source platform that unites the best signal intelligence tools into a single, accessible interface.
readme_summary: iNTERCEPT is an open-source, web-based platform that unifies various signal intelligence (SIGINT) tools into a single interface. It supports a wide range of functionalities from radio decoding and tracking to counter-surveillance and space weather monitoring.
primary_use_case: Consolidating and providing a unified interface for a diverse set of radio frequency (RF) and signal intelligence tools for monitoring, tracking, decoding, and analysis.
cover_image_prompt: A sophisticated, multi-faceted signal intelligence hub visualized as an intricate, glowing control panel. At its center, a holographic globe displays real-time tracking of aircraft and ships, overlaid with radio wave patterns. Various smaller screens show decoded data streams, satellite imagery, and spectrum analysis. Subtle digital particles and data streams flow between these elements, representing the integration of diverse tools. The repository name 'iNTERCEPT' is subtly etched into the console's design. The scene is set in a dimly lit, futuristic command center with a cool blue and green color palette, emphasizing data and connectivity. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clarity and a sense of comprehensive monitoring.

name: zen
description: Selfhosted notes app. Single golang binary, notes stored as markdown within SQLite, full-text search, very low resource usage
readme_summary: Zen is a self-hosted notes application that stores notes as Markdown files in a local SQLite database. It offers features like full-text search, flexible tagging, and data portability, all within a single, low-resource binary.
key_features: Single Go binary or Docker Compose
Standard Markdown files, local SQLite database
Import and export data with full portability
primary_use_case: A self-hosted, lightweight, and portable note-taking application for managing personal knowledge.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian meticulously organizing a vast, interconnected library of glowing scrolls. Each scroll represents a Markdown note, and the librarian uses a magical magnifying glass (representing full-text search) to find specific information instantly. The library shelves are made of glowing SQLite blocks, and flexible, colorful ribbons (representing tags) connect related scrolls, bypassing rigid folder structures. Subtle digital particles and faint code snippets float in the air, hinting at the underlying technology. The scene is bathed in warm, ambient light, creating a cozy and efficient atmosphere. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clarity and a touch of magic.
